source_mechanisms.fact: max_query_len>=8192 routes C16; c4_member_pipeline only replaces C4; mdl_decode only replaces q4/q1.
C16 runs sixteen sequential FP32 QK/softmax/PV member chains per KV256; online member state spills to bounded GM, H16 unpack remains.
Short mixed partition retains original cv_shape_tokens; large original shape selects S1 even after partition.
